description: Relocatable object-code format produced by ND-500(0) compilers/assemblers and consumed by the old Linkage-Loader (NLL) and the ND Linker.

verification.status: control byte bit order VERIFIED against a real compiler-produced file (nd-500-apf-lib-e.nrf)
verification.sourceFile: nd-500-apf-lib-e.nrf, from the ND-500 microcode set kept outside this repository

data.note: parity bit cleared; leading '#' marks a hidden symbol

controlNumbers.name: NUL
controlNumbers.description: Ignored. NL must be 0.

controlNumbers.name: BEG
controlNumbers.description: Start of module.

controlNumbers.name: END
controlNumbers.description: End of module. NL = checksum size (0=no test, 2=default). Checksum = sum of BEG..END bytes, 2's complement.

controlNumbers.name: MSA
controlNumbers.description: Main start address := current BP (+ numeric value).

controlNumbers.name: LIB
controlNumbers.description: Library conditional-load symbol.

controlNumbers.name: DEF
controlNumbers.description: Program symbol definition. NL=0: value:=PP. NL!=0: value:=numeric field.

controlNumbers.name: REF
controlNumbers.description: Program symbol reference at current BP.

controlNumbers.name: LRF
controlNumbers.description: Like REF if symbol already defined; else stores zero.

controlNumbers.name: DDF
controlNumbers.description: Data symbol definition (DEF for DP).

controlNumbers.name: DRF
controlNumbers.description: Data symbol reference (REF for DP).

controlNumbers.name: RMV
controlNumbers.description: Remove symbol from loader table.

controlNumbers.name: SLA
controlNumbers.description: Set load address. BP := numeric value (+ symbol value if SL!=0).

controlNumbers.name: AJS
controlNumbers.description: Adjust. BP += signed numeric value.

controlNumbers.name: PMO
controlNumbers.description: Set program mode. PP += numeric value; BP:=PP.

controlNumbers.name: DMO
controlNumbers.description: Set data mode. DP += numeric value; BP:=DP.

controlNumbers.name: FMO
controlNumbers.description: Set free mode. BP:=XP:=BP+numeric value (or symbol value + numeric value).

controlNumbers.name: REP
controlNumbers.description: Repeat next group N times (numeric value).

controlNumbers.name: LDI
controlNumbers.description: Load NL immediate bytes at BP; BP+=NL. Max 7 bytes.

controlNumbers.name: ADI
controlNumbers.description: Add numeric value into NL bytes at BP; BP+=NL.

controlNumbers.name: APA
controlNumbers.description: PP+numeric value stored into next ADL bytes; BP+=ADL.

controlNumbers.name: ADA
controlNumbers.description: DP+numeric value stored into next ADL bytes; BP+=ADL.

controlNumbers.name: IHB
controlNumbers.description: Execution inhibit - NRF incomplete due to compile errors.

controlNumbers.name: EOF
controlNumbers.description: End of NRF file.

controlNumbers.name: DBG
controlNumbers.description: Debug start/stop marker.

controlNumbers.name: LBB
controlNumbers.description: Library module byte-pointer (fast-load vector entry).

controlNumbers.name: MSG
controlNumbers.description: Print symbolic field's ASCII string; '$' (36 dec) -> CR+LF.

controlNumbers.name: MIS
controlNumbers.description: Miscellaneous; numeric field = subcontrol number.

subcontrols.name: ADD
subcontrols.description: Add next referenced symbol's value at BP.

subcontrols.name: SUB
subcontrols.description: Subtract next referenced symbol's value at BP.

subcontrols.name: MUL
subcontrols.description: Multiply value at BP by next referenced symbol.

subcontrols.name: DIV
subcontrols.description: Divide value at BP by next referenced symbol.

controlNumbers.name: LDN
controlNumbers.description: Load N bytes immediately, no symbolic field.

controlNumbers.name: IL1
controlNumbers.description: Illegal (reserved).

controlNumbers.name: IL2
controlNumbers.description: Illegal (reserved).

controlNumbers.name: IL3
controlNumbers.description: Illegal (reserved).

controlNumbers.name: IL4
controlNumbers.description: Illegal (reserved).

symbolTypeBits.name: DREF
symbolTypeBits.description: false = program memory reference, true = data memory reference

symbolTypeBits.name: DSYM
symbolTypeBits.description: false = program label, true = data label

symbolTypeBits.name: GLOB
symbolTypeBits.description: true = symbol survives a loader-table save

symbolTypeBits.name: OMIT
symbolTypeBits.description: true = module must not be loaded
